subject: monsterTruck
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: monster truck with huge tyres.
Style: pixel art.
reasoning:
I'm sketching the monster truck's real-world proportions (tall tires, wide chassis, ~5.5m length) and planning to build it with pixel-kit parts and joints for the chassis and wheels.

I'm working out exact coordinates for axles, shocks, chassis rails, body panels (hood, cab, bed), fender flares, and details like bumpers, lights, exhausts, and decals, plus how the low-poly cylinder tires will be shaped and textured.

Adding tread blocks, hub bolts, and rim details to the wheel geometry, then setting up a pixel-art cell-shaded paint palette for the body color with a flame decal pattern near the bottom.

Working out the tire geometry... I'm sizing the tread blocks so they sink slightly into the tire radius with proper offset, then setting up staggered rows of angled blocks around the wheel circumference.

I'm positioning the wheel joints relative to the chassis, attaching the tire cylinders with the correct orientation, then moving on to writing out the full body code with paint colors and shape definitions, including a slanted windshield plane for the cab.

Adding roof light bar, headlights, and taillights...
